// This fixture is compiled with the pinned released source.
func TestWriteReleasedUpgradeFixture(t *testing.T) {
	if db.GenerationTwoSchemaHash() != "f497335da8efcdd49132bc9d7c3d97bf8bb41dc5f2ca14ce557871ddc76e5c17" || db.PinnedGenerationTwoManifestHash != "484bf7ee92aec1dfb9c8750e9bb1a73b2b4b5d1e9761e1f86c5dcd31d2719f23" || db.PinnedGenerationTwoFreshConfigSeedHash != "9773098cd2282c59dbecb6062ba1a64a13b4e0b0bf8c43845c152ced03d813d5" {
		t.Fatal("wrong released schema")
	}
	path := os.Getenv("NONBIRI_RELEASED_FIXTURE")
	if path == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing fixture destination")
	}
	dbfixture.Materialize(t, path)
	vault, err := secret.New(bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x42}, secret.MasterKeyBytes))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer vault.Close()
	store, err := db.Open(path, vault)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer store.Close()
	ctx := context.Background()
	tx := beginLedgerTestTx(t, store.DB())
	defer tx.Rollback()
	var users []int64
	for i, amount := range []int64{37000, -7000} {
		user, general := seedLedgerUser(t, tx, []string{"dual-positive", "dual-negative"}[i])
		users = append(users, user)
		game, err := CreateUserAssetAccount(ctx, tx, user, Game, ledgerTestNow)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		external, err := CodedAccount(ctx, tx, "external")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		gameExternal, err := CodedAssetAccount(ctx, tx, "external", Game)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		balance := AmountFromMilli(amount)
		if i == 0 {
			balance, err = ParseAmount("9000000000000000")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		plan, err := NewAdminUserAdjustment(Meta{OperationID: mustLedgerID(t, "op_"), ActorUserID: user, CreatedAt: ledgerTestNow}, general.ID, external.ID, balance, 0, Amount{}, "synthetic balance")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, err := Apply(ctx, tx, plan); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		meta := Meta{OperationID: mustLedgerID(t, "op_"), ActorUserID: user, CreatedAt: ledgerTestNow}
		award, err := NewGameCheckinAward(meta, game.ID, gameExternal.ID, AmountFromMilli(12000))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, err := Apply(ctx, tx, award); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, err := tx.Exec(`INSERT INTO game_checkins(user_id,site_day,award_milli,operation_id,created_at) VALUES(?,'2023-11-14',12000,?,?)`, user, meta.OperationID, ledgerTestNow); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if i == 0 {
			for _, delta := range []int64{100000, 100000, -100000, 0} {
				change, err := NewAdminUserAdjustment(Meta{OperationID: mustLedgerID(t, "op_"), ActorUserID: user, CreatedAt: ledgerTestNow}, general.ID, external.ID, Amount{}, user, AmountFromMilli(delta), "synthetic donation adjustment")
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if _, err := Apply(ctx, tx, change); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			if _, err := tx.Exec(`UPDATE users SET game_profile_public=1 WHERE id=?`, user); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		var until any
		if i == 1 {
			until = int64(253400000000)
		}
		if _, err := tx.Exec(`UPDATE users SET is_banned=1,auto_banned=1,banned_reason='Automatic RPM restriction',banned_until=?,charity_suspended_until=? WHERE id=?`, until, 253400000000, user); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	for key, value := range map[string]string{"site_name": "Synthetic dual wallet fixture", "legal_privacy_override_en": "Synthetic privacy.\nPreserve this text.", "game_fishing_rtp": "90", "game_fishing_rtp_premium": "88"} {
		if _, err := tx.Exec(`UPDATE site_config SET value=?,updated_at=? WHERE key=?`, value, ledgerTestNow, key); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	seedReleasedGovernanceFacts(t, tx, vault, users)
	seedReleasedEconomyAuditProjection(t, tx, users)
	seedReleasedLakeNotes(t, tx, users[0])
	seedReleasedGachaFacts(t, tx, users[0])
	if err := ValidateRecovery(ctx, tx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	review, err := secret.NewDonationReview(vault)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := review.Initialize(ctx, store.DB()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := store.DB().Exec(`PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)`); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := store.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

type releasedLakeRandom struct{}

func (releasedLakeRandom) Float53() (float64, error) { return 0.5, nil }

func seedReleasedLakeNotes(t *testing.T, tx *sql.Tx, user int64) {
	t.Helper()
	profile := rules.InitialProfile()
	profile.Coins = "3700"
	profile.OwnedGear = append(profile.OwnedGear, "trainingRod")
	profile.BaitStock["basic"] = 7
	profile, cast, err := rules.Start(profile, releasedLakeRandom{}, 17)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cast.Paused = true
	profileRaw, err := rules.EncodeProfile(profile)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	castRaw, err := rules.EncodeCast(cast)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	coins, err := db.ParseU128Decimal(string(profile.Coins))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	period := mustLedgerID(t, "lnp_")
	if _, err := tx.Exec(`INSERT INTO lake_notes_periods(id,name,revision,status,starts_at,ends_at,entry_fee_milli,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,'Saved lake',1,'published',?,?,0,?,?)`, period, ledgerTestNow-100, ledgerTestNow+100, ledgerTestNow, ledgerTestNow); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec(`INSERT INTO lake_notes_profiles(user_id,revision,rules_id,coin_mag,profile,updated_at) VALUES(?,2,?,?,?,?)`, user, rules.RulesID, db.EncodeU128(coins), profileRaw, ledgerTestNow); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec(`INSERT INTO lake_notes_casts(id,user_id,source_period_id,rules_id,phase,paused,generation,revision,last_tick,snapshot,reward_plan,held,active_elapsed_ns,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,'waiting',1,1,2,0,?,X'7b7d',0,0,?,?)`, mustLedgerID(t, "lnc_"), user, period, rules.RulesID, castRaw, ledgerTestNow, ledgerTestNow); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec(`INSERT INTO lake_notes_entitlements(user_id,period_id,fee_milli,period_revision,operation_key_hash,created_at) VALUES(?,?,0,1,zeroblob(32),?)`, user, period, ledgerTestNow); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestReleasedRejectsStableSchema(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("NONBIRI_STABLE_UPGRADED_FIXTURE")
	if path == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing upgraded fixture")
	}
	before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	vault, err := secret.New(bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x42}, secret.MasterKeyBytes))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer vault.Close()
	store, err := db.Open(path, vault)
	if store != nil {
		store.Close()
		t.Fatal("released binary accepted the new schema")
	}
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("released binary did not reject the new schema")
	}
	after, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil || sha256.Sum256(before) != sha256.Sum256(after) {
		t.Fatal("rejection modified the database", err)
	}
}

func seedReleasedGachaFacts(t *testing.T, tx *sql.Tx, user int64) {
	t.Helper()
	pool := mustLedgerID(t, "gp_")
	queries := []struct {
		query string
		args  []any
	}{
		{"INSERT INTO gacha_pools(id,config,revision,created_at) SELECT ?,config,7,? FROM gacha_presets ORDER BY id LIMIT 1", []any{pool, ledgerTestNow}},
		{"INSERT INTO gacha_config_events(actor_user_id,target,revision,config,created_at) SELECT ?,id,revision,config,created_at FROM gacha_pools WHERE id=?", []any{user, pool}},
		{"INSERT INTO gacha_profiles(user_id,permanent,limited,n_shards,r_shards,sr_shards,ssr_shards,newcomer,checked_day,month,monthly_permanent,monthly_limited,entered_at,updated_at,limited_checked_day,welcome_granted) VALUES(?,37,11,9,7,5,3,0,'2023-11-14','2023-11',4,2,?,?,'2023-11-14',1)", []any{user, ledgerTestNow, ledgerTestNow}},
		{"INSERT INTO gacha_owned(user_id,card_id,obtained_at,source) VALUES(?,'a-chatgpt',?,'reward')", []any{user, ledgerTestNow}},
		{"INSERT INTO gacha_pity(user_id,group_id,sr,ssr,sr_limit,ssr_limit,sr_featured,ssr_featured,ssr_misses) VALUES(?,'permanent',3,42,10,90,1,0,1)", []any{user}},
		{"INSERT INTO gacha_claims(user_id,kind,target,created_at) VALUES(?,'card','a-chatgpt',?)", []any{user, ledgerTestNow}},
		{"UPDATE gacha_presets SET name='Edited synthetic template',revision=8 WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM gacha_presets ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)", nil},
	}
	for _, item := range queries {
		if _, err := tx.Exec(item.query, item.args...); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}
